# freew.org

> freew.org presents apps and repositories you can use without paying, by Pengfan Chang (Swipht Group). The catalog lists Amber Phosphor, COBOL, CTMU, Gas Plasma, iB-theme, P1PW, Pascal, RockyBack, and WordPerfect Blue. RockyBack, Pascal, and COBOL are proprietary, and their published licenses grant no permission to use them.

swiphtgroup.com is the main Swipht Group site: https://swiphtgroup.com/
clambercloud.com is the related Clamber site: https://clambercloud.com/
The catalog is also published as XML: https://freew.org/site.xml

## Pages

- [Home](https://freew.org/index.html.md): Canonical page: https://freew.org/
- [Pricing](https://freew.org/pricing/index.html.md): Canonical page: https://freew.org/pricing/
- [Donate](https://freew.org/donate/index.html.md): Canonical page: https://freew.org/donate/
- [Amber Phosphor](https://freew.org/amberphosphor/index.html.md): a terminal theme for Apple Terminal and iTerm2. Free of charge, and free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3. Source: https://github.com/JohnThre/AmberPhosphor-theme. Canonical page: https://freew.org/amberphosphor/
- [COBOL](https://freew.org/cobol/index.html.md): COBOL support for the Nova editor in fixed and free format, with embedded SQL, symbols, copybook-aware completions and navigation, record layouts, clips, format tools, and GnuCOBOL build, run, debugging, and diagnostics. The published license grants no permission to use it. Proprietary, and not free software. Source: https://github.com/JohnThre/COBOL.novaextension. License: https://github.com/JohnThre/COBOL.novaextension/blob/main/LICENSE. Canonical page: https://freew.org/cobol/
- [CTMU](https://freew.org/ctmu/index.html.md): a command-line tool for macOS. Free of charge, and free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3. Source: https://github.com/JohnThre/CTMU-for-macOS. Canonical page: https://freew.org/ctmu/
- [Gas Plasma](https://freew.org/gasplasma/index.html.md): an orange-dominant dark theme for Apple Terminal, iTerm2, VS Code, and Zed. Free of charge, and free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later. Source: https://github.com/JohnThre/GasPlasma-theme. Canonical page: https://freew.org/gasplasma/
- [iB-theme](https://freew.org/ibtheme/index.html.md): an IBM Carbon theme for Cursor, VS Code, GNU Emacs, Vim, Neovim, CotEditor, Apple Terminal, and iTerm2. Free of charge, and free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later. Source: https://github.com/JohnThre/iB-theme. Canonical page: https://freew.org/ibtheme/
- [P1PW](https://freew.org/p1pw/index.html.md): a warm, paper-toned light theme for Apple Terminal. Free of charge, and free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3. Source: https://github.com/JohnThre/P1PW-theme. Canonical page: https://freew.org/p1pw/
- [Pascal](https://freew.org/pascal/index.html.md): Pascal and Object Pascal support for the Nova editor, with syntax, symbols, completions, clips, ptop formatting, and Free Pascal build, run, and diagnostics. The published license grants no permission to use it. Proprietary, and not free software. Source: https://github.com/JohnThre/Pascal.novaextension. License: https://github.com/JohnThre/Pascal.novaextension/blob/main/LICENSE. Canonical page: https://freew.org/pascal/
- [RockyBack](https://freew.org/rockyback/index.html.md): prepares Rocky Linux 9 or AlmaLinux 9 and installs ClambBack. The published license grants no permission to use it. Proprietary, and not free software. Source: https://github.com/JohnThre/rockyback. License: https://github.com/JohnThre/rockyback/blob/main/LICENSE. Canonical page: https://freew.org/rockyback/
- [WordPerfect Blue](https://freew.org/wordperfectblue/index.html.md): a WordPerfect 5.1 white-on-blue theme for Apple Terminal. Free of charge, and free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3. Source: https://github.com/JohnThre/WordPerfectBlue-theme. Canonical page: https://freew.org/wordperfectblue/

## Pricing terms

- Free of charge: no payment is required to use the work.
- Free software: freedom to use, study, share, and change the work. Free of charge is not the same thing.

## Donate

- Liberapay: https://en.liberapay.com/jpfchang/
- Ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/jpfchang
- IssueHunt: https://oss.issuehunt.io/u/johnthre

Donations are optional. They do not grant a license, and they do not grant permission to use RockyBack, Pascal, or COBOL.
